$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-repository-cell.mjs (srs#651), each citing the live or ratified issue that explains it. Entry shape: {path, reason, disposition, issue} — the same shape as scripts/publication-reachability-exclusions.json (carried-context-61cee7c6), reused rather than inventing a bespoke one. `disposition: "permanent"` means the exception is a ruled, settled outcome that never expires by issue state; it still expires if the file stops existing or the key is removed (checked below regardless of disposition). `disposition: "pending"` means real follow-up remains and `issue` MUST cite a currently-open issue. The check fails on any violation NOT listed here and on any entry that no longer matches a violation — shrinking this file IS the fix; growing it needs an issue.
